topology: fully balanced push-pull class A, directly heated 2A3 output, 6C45 drivers, tube rectified

2A3.note: Directly heated power triode, 2.5 V / 2.5 A filament, 15 W plate. Four in push-pull. 300B does not fit.

6C45.note: 6S45P-E / 6C45Pi single high-transconductance triode, noval base. Drives the 2A3 grids.

5U4G.note: Full-wave rectifier, octal base, 5 V filament. 274B is the usual upgrade in this socket; voltage drop and current rating differ.

stock_tubes.note: Stock brands to be confirmed by the facts-wa33 research lane.

facts.claim: Woo's quick-start guide lists four 2A3 power tubes in the WA33 2nd-generation box, so the amp uses a quad of 2A3 power tubes.
Woo's quick-start guide lists one 5U4G rectifier tube for the WA33 2nd generation, identifying the stock rectifier family and count.
Woo's quick-start guide lists four 6C45 driver tubes for the WA33 2nd generation, so the driver complement is a matched four-tube set by count.
Woo says the Standard and Elite WA33 2nd-generation versions ship with the same default tube set; the maker page lists tube types and counts but does not identify shipped tube brands.
facts.snippet: Default tubes are same for all versions

facts.claim: Woo's product-page box list names the in-box rectifier as 5U4G with 5U3C in parentheses, so the verified stock rectifier entry is 5U4G/5U3C, one tube.
Woo's Takatsuki TA-274B page treats the TA-274B as a rectifier tube and lists WA33/WA33 Elite Edition in its compatibility section.
Woo sells Electro Harmonix 6C45Pi as the WA33 driver-tube variant and describes it as performing in the WA33, confirming 6C45Pi within the 6C45 driver family.
Woo's Takatsuki TA-2A3 quad page lists WA33 Standard and Elite Edition compatibility specifically as a quad, matching the WA33's four-2A3 requirement.
facts.snippet: WA33 Standard and Elite Edition - quad

facts.claim: Woo's WE300B compatibility list names WA5/WA234MONO/3ES models rather than WA33; together with Woo's WA33 2A3 power-tube listing, this supports treating 300B as not fitting the WA33.
Woo's current variant data lists the WA33 2nd-generation Standard edition at USD 9,999.00; the sale-price field is present but the variant is marked not on sale.
Woo's current variant data lists the WA33 2nd-generation Elite Edition at USD 16,999.00; the sale-price field is present but the variant is marked not on sale.
Woo describes the 2nd-generation WA33 as adding direct-drive current output for True Ribbon headphones, a key functional change from the earlier WA33 use case.
facts.snippet: introduce direct-drive current output for True Ribbon headphones

facts.claim: Woo says the Elite Edition adds upgraded output transformers, single-crystal wiring, upgraded volume control, Mundorf capacitors, premium connectors, and a gold-plated plaque.
facts.snippet: Ultra high-bandwidth, low-loss output transformers custom-made

facts.claim: Woo states that the WA33 is self-biasing when compatible tubes are used, so tube rolling should stay within compatible tube families rather than requiring manual bias adjustment.
Woo's quick-start tube-installation instructions say to handle tubes with clean hands or gloves, which is a handling precaution before installing or rolling tubes.
facts.snippet: Handle tubes with clean hands or use gloves

facts.claim: Woo instructs users to allow the WA33 tubes five to ten minutes after power-on to reach operating temperature before judging or using the amp normally.
facts.snippet: minutes for the tubes to reach operating temperature

facts.claim: Woo's 2A3 installation procedure tells the user to hold the tube base firmly and align both the thick and thin pins before seating the 2A3 tubes.
facts.snippet: Allign both the THICK & thin pins

facts.claim: Woo's quick-start guide includes a dedicated step for installing the single 5U4G tube and shows its guide-pin orientation for correct rectifier placement.
Woo's quick-start guide includes a dedicated installation step for the four 6C45 tubes and calls attention to tube-pin orientation.

dimensions.layout: two stacked blocks: amplifier above, power supply below (Internal Coupling Architecture, no umbilical)
dimensions.front_panel: centre volume knob; left to right: 4-pin XLR (ribbon), 6.3 mm TRS, 4.4 mm balanced, 4-pin XLR balanced; toggles for input, impedance, output
dimensions.rear_panel: two balanced XLR input pairs, one RCA pair, one balanced XLR pre-out pair on the upper block; AC inlet and voltage selector on the lower block
dimensions.source: summary supplied by Jas 2026-10-12 citing wooaudio.com, audioadvisor.com, mimic-audio.com; verify against Woo's spec sheet

layout_note: Positions measured from Jas's top-down photo of his WA33 Gen 2 (2026-10-12): the five big tubes form an arc (outer 2A3s forward, inner 2A3s back, 5U4G centre-forward); the four 6C45 form a second arc in front (outer pair forward). Chassis: upper amp block on pillars over the power block; five knobs on the upper face; gold port plate + power ring on the lower face.
